mapper.select: SELECT a.homepage_id, a.menu_idx, b.menu_name, TO_CHAR(a.add_date, ) AS result_date, TRUNC(SUM(menu_rating_score)/COUNT(menu_rating_score), 2) AS rating_average_score FROM MENU_RATING a, CMS_MENU b WHERE a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND a.menu_idx = b.menu_idx AND a.homepage_id = 'h1' AND to_date(a.add_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= TO_DATE(#{search_start_date}) AND to_date(a.add_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= TO_DATE(#{search_end_date}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(a.add_date, ), a.homepage_id, a.menu_idx, b.menu_name ORDER BY TO_CHAR(a.add_date, ) ASC, menu_idx ASC;
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(menu_rating_idx), 0) + 1 FROM MENU_RATING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND menu_idx = #{menu_idx}
INSERT INTO MENU_RATING ( homepage_id, menu_idx, menu_rating_idx, menu_rating_score, add_id, add_date ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{menu_idx}, #{menu_rating_idx}, #{menu_rating_score}, #{add_id}, SYSDATE )
